description:
• Brand introduction:
Else Maric is a sophisticated jewelry and accessories brand founded by Kristine, named after her late aunt Else. Inspired by Kristine's love for timeless fashion and elegant design, the brand is a tribute to her heritage and passion for style. Else Maric offers quality pieces that effortlessly complement any outfit, combining modern design with classic elements. The brand aims to elevate everyday looks with luxury accessories that are both functional and chic.

• Product description:

Else Maric offers an exclusive range of jewelry and fashion accessories, including elegant earrings, necklaces, bracelets, and specialty items like high-end pantyhose. Each piece is designed to bring a touch of sophistication and style to any wardrobe. The jewelry is crafted with attention to detail, using premium materials that ensure longevity, while the accessories are designed to enhance simple outfits, making them perfect for every occasion.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):
Else Maric’s unique selling point lies in its ability to offer luxury, high end designs and timeless style at an accessible price point. 
 
• Payment terms:
Affiliates of Else Maric will receive a 15% commission on sales generated through their unique referral links/ vouchers, excluding shipping costs. The tracking cookie duration is set to 30 days. Payments will be processed monthly via PayPal after the customer’s return period has ended. Only completed and non-returned sales will be eligible for commission.
